items.q: And we had Jim Chapin, Harry Chapin's father, doing a jazz performance at the college.

ctx.x: Now, in Ain't Misbehavin', which is a musical about Fats Waller's life, except it doesn't do justice to him, as J.C. says, (inaudible) really about him, but three of the songs in there are songs that J.C. collaborated with him on, including -- I don't think you watch television. He doesn't watch television.
